'''Samalin Naerodan''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Green Ajah]] and a [[Sitter]] in the [[Salidar Hall]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Samalin Naerodan|comp}}

== Appearance and Personality ==
Samalin is a fox-faced [[Murandian]] with a mannish stride.{{ref/book|10|19}}

Despite being sharp-faced she has a surprising sense of humour and a bright, clear laugh.

==Strength and Personality==
Samalin has a strength in the [[One Power]] of {{opsl|28}}, [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|average]] for an Aes Sedai. She would not be strong enough to [[Traveling|Travel]] unless she has an above average skill in the Talent.

== History==
Samalin is [[Murandian]] and 65 years old; she was born in the year [[935 NE]] and went to the [[White Tower]] in {{ne|952}}. After spending six years as [[novice]] and five as [[Accepted]] she was raised to the shawl in the year {{ne|963}}.{{ref||comp}}

Samalin has only one [[Warder]], to whom she is married, though that is not widely known.

== Activities ==

She was elected as a Sitter in the Rebel Hall of the Tower. She is one of the Sitters whom [[Siuan Sanche]] identifies as being too young for the position.

She is one of the Aes Sedai in the [[Little Tower]] who rejects [[Egwene al'Vere]] as [[Amyrlin]] in the first vote. But she stood immediately for Egwene the second time.

She votes to declare war on [[Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan]] in the first round of voting. She also votes to ally with the [[Black Tower]] and to accept the offer from the [[Dragon Reborn]] to allow sisters to bond forty-seven [[Asha'man]].

She was unseated upon the reunification of the [[White Tower]] due to being surplus to requirements. [[Farnah Sadaou]] replaced the Black Ajah Sitter [[Talene Minly]], while the other two positions continued to be held by the previous incumbents [[Faiselle Darone]] and [[Rubinde Acedone]].

It is presumed that she fought in and survived the [[Last Battle]].
